'''Star Tours Flight 1026''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1B at 0835 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0930.
